_about: Online 1v1 versus (owner, 2026-10-11 and 2026-10-16). Each player brings team heroes at level, with their chosen ascensions and one fixed purple set per class. The map is size x size, random but mirrored so neither side gets better ground. Each turn may last turnSeconds; each player has bankSeconds for the whole match. Running out of turn time ends the turn; running out of your total time loses the match.
